svg.title: Adorable Fluffy Kitten
svg.desc: A highly detailed, cute vector illustration of a sitting fluffy kitten with large expressive eyes, layered fluffy fur using multiple paths and ellipses, detailed inner ears, long whiskers, button nose, cute mouth, soft gradient shading, curled tail, playful paw, resting on a soft pink cushion beside a ball of pastel yarn. Created with reusable defs for gradients. (Candidate 4 implementation)
